name: Inside Agentic AI: Popular Frameworks
description:
Skillsoft issued completion badges are earned based on viewing the percentage required or receiving a passing score when assessment is required. Agentic AI systems don't start from scratch. They are built on powerful frameworks designed to orchestrate memory, planning, tool use, and multi-agent collaboration.

In this course, explore today's most popular agentic AI frameworks, including LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, Haystack, and n8n. Next, discover how each framework functions, where it fits in the agent lifecycle, and when it should be used. Finally, learn how to choose and apply the right tools, whether you are building a smart assistant, an autonomous researcher, or a multi-agent workflow.

After completing this course, you will be able to outline widely used agentic AI frameworks.
